highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 delivers the stable Skia m150 renderer with new image-filter and culling APIs.
highlights_body: It also improves raster blur behavior and reduces repeated wrapper allocations when accessing an SKSurface canvas.

bullets.detail: Brings the Chrome m150 renderer and its subsequent upstream fixes to the stable 4.150 line.
Adds crop and empty image filters, overdraw visualization, and SKPaint.GetFastBounds for quick-reject culling.
Restores expected rendering behavior for raster blurs with small sigma values.
Repeated SKSurface.Canvas access reuses its managed wrapper instead of allocating a new wrapper each time.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Small-radius raster blur correction and SKSurface canvas wrapper caching

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.150 line with the Skia m150 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the new image-filter and visualization APIs alongside the HarfBuzz update.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 completed the line with rendering and SKSurface performance improvements.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native dependency to 14.2.1.
